supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:57 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 recorded a network logon for sam.okafor from WS-SOKAFOR-01, matching the inventory's authorized remote-administration host.
At 13:42:01 UTC, PowerShell ran as NWD\sam.okafor under the same logon ID, invoking \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1, the organization's documented workstation-patching script.
That PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows update package, and proxy telemetry records a Windows Update Agent download of about 38.8 MB at the same time.
The PowerShell process ended at 13:42:47 UTC; the observed sequence is consistent with the scheduled business-hours patching practice and explains the reported brief PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show process execution at 13:42:01 UTC, not the exact time or appearance of the reported window around 13:40 UTC.
The logs show the PowerShell command line and the update package launched, but not the contents or integrity of Apply-Updates.ps1, nor whether the update installation completed successfully.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish the precise on-screen window behavior Ivy reported.
The available records do not establish the contents or provenance of the update script or the final installation outcome.
unrelated_findings: For separate review: Firefox accessed a Citrix StoreWeb page at customer.cloud.com; this may be remote-access activity, which is not listed as approved in the supplied inventory. The records show the launch and web requests, but do not establish whether this use was authorized (T044-00163, T044-00171, T044-00172).

For separate review: a process recorded as Cisco Spark Webex.exe was launched with an app.slack.com URL. This is unrelated to the PowerShell patching activity; the records do not establish whether Slack use is authorized (T044-00168, T044-00170).

For separate review: DC-NWD-01 initiated connections toward WS-ICHEN-01 on ports 8080, 443, 445, and 135; the available records show rejected or incomplete connections and do not establish their purpose (T044-00127, T044-00128, T044-00129, T044-00130, T044-00131, T044-00132, T044-00133, T044-00134).
